notes: S4.3 states without qualification that only valid write transfers modify the registers and that reads or invalid accesses have no register side effects. As a candidate property this requires a non-reset condition: synchronous reset has highest priority and can change the register state even on an edge that otherwise carries a read or invalid transfer. S1-S3 and the final RTL correctly implement the intended APB behavior, and trusted simulation and bounded formal verification pass all obligations.
